name: Oumar
source:
A newbie at the CSF.

Oumar has a cheerful personality. Not only is he outgoing, he is also considerate of other people. Thus, when Shou is in trouble, he is there to point him in the right direction. They met while in training, and Oumar has had Shou's back ever since. That's why Oumar is the only person who Shou can open his mind to. Oumar is good at sniping. Therefore, his job is to protect Shou in the battlefield. The relationship between the two men is strong.
